heroTagline: FORGING THE FUTURE OF ENTREPRENEURSHIP & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
heroSubtext: Dayananda Sagar University's premier innovation ecosystem uniting engineers, designers, researchers, and student founders.

landingContent.aboutText: To cultivate a vibrant community at DSU, fostering innovation in AI and entrepreneurship through collaborative projects.
landingContent.pillarsSubtext: Our approach to innovation is built on three core strategies.

pillars.title: Innovation
pillars.description: We encourage groundbreaking ideas and provide the resources for members to explore the frontiers of AI and business.

pillars.title: Collaboration
pillars.description: We believe in the power of diverse minds working together, fostering a supportive environment for shared learning and growth.

pillars.title: Impact
pillars.description: Our projects aim to solve real-world problems, making a tangible difference in the community and beyond.

landingContent.projectsSubtext: Showcasing our creations. Explore our innovative projects, where theory meets practice in the exciting fields of AI and entrepreneurship.

projects.title: Project Alpha
projects.description: An AI-powered solution for optimizing campus resource allocation, developed by our student engineers.

projects.title: Venture Beta
projects.description: A student-led startup focusing on sustainable urban farming using intelligent automation and data analytics.

projects.title: Design Delta
projects.description: A creative project exploring the intersection of generative AI and digital art, showcasing student artistic talent.

projects.title: Research Gamma
projects.description: Cutting-edge research into explainable AI for ethical decision-making in financial technology.

landingContent.approachSubtext: Where your ambition meets innovation. We foster a dynamic environment where students transform ideas into impactful ventures.

approach.title: Ideation
approach.description: We guide members from initial concepts to well-defined project proposals, encouraging creative problem-solving.

approach.title: Development
approach.description: Providing tools, mentorship, and a collaborative space for building and refining AI solutions and business models.

approach.title: Launch
approach.description: Supporting projects through deployment, market entry, and continuous iteration for sustained success.

approach.title: Mentorship
approach.description: Connecting students with industry experts and faculty advisors for invaluable guidance and insights.

approach.title: Community
approach.description: Building a strong network of innovators, fostering peer learning and collaborative opportunities.

testimonials.name: Aisha Sharma
testimonials.quote: Ai Foundry transformed my understanding of AI and gave me the confidence to launch my own startup idea.

testimonials.name: Rahul Verma
testimonials.quote: The collaborative environment here is unparalleled. I've learned so much from my peers and mentors.

testimonials.name: Priya Singh
testimonials.quote: Being part of Ai Foundry has opened doors to incredible opportunities and a network I wouldn't have otherwise.
